title: Black students made up 18.7% of Valley Stream North High School enrollment in 2025-26
text:
The New York State Education Department reported that Valley Stream North High School had 222 Black students enrolled for the 2025-26 school year, reflecting a 7.9% decrease from the prior year.
For the same period, the school served 1,189 students in total. Black students accounted for 18.7% of the overall enrollment, making them the third least represented ethnic group at the school.
Valley Stream North High School is part of the Valley Stream Central High School District, with district offices based in Franklin Square.
Among the district’s four schools, Valley Stream Central High School had the most Black students enrolled at the time, totaling 406 students.
A World Population Review analysis ranked New York’s public education system second nationwide , while placing it 31st for K-12 performance.
